categories.hidden_payload: code or markup hidden inside a non-code container
categories.code_execution: code or command execution reachable from request input
categories.identity: the file is not what it claims to be
categories.network: upload or command traffic inside a capture
categories.metadata: shape and statistics of the file itself

rules.title: PHP before the image signature
rules.rationale: Bytes before the image signature mean the file is PHP that carries a picture, not a picture.

rules.title: PHP hidden inside an image
rules.rationale: A picture never contains PHP: the metadata segment or the tail carries a payload.

rules.title: Markup in image metadata
rules.rationale: Script markup in a metadata segment turns the image into a stored-XSS carrier.

rules.title: ZIP archive after the end of image
rules.rationale: A ZIP local header after the image trailer makes the file a PHAR polyglot.

rules.title: Data after the end of image
rules.rationale: Non-image bytes after the trailer are suspicious even when they are not code; the specific rule wins when they are.

rules.title: Extension does not match the magic bytes
rules.rationale: The extension claims one type and the bytes say another: the container is lying about itself.

rules.title: Executable double extension
rules.rationale: A name like shell.php.jpg targets servers that resolve the last extension but filter on the first.

rules.title: PHP open tag
rules.rationale: Gate only: a PHP tag inside a container that should not hold PHP unlocks the hidden-payload rules.

rules.title: Execution sink call
rules.rationale: Gate only: a call to a function that executes code or commands is the trigger for the sink rules.

rules.title: Request superglobal read
rules.rationale: Gate only: reading request input is what turns a sink into an input-fed sink.

rules.title: Decoder call
rules.rationale: Gate only: a decoder call is the trigger for the obfuscation ladder.

rules.title: Large base64 literal
rules.rationale: Gate only: a long base64 literal suggests a packed payload; the weight belongs to the structural rules.

rules.title: Known webshell family fingerprint
rules.rationale: Gate only: a family fingerprint unlocks PHP_KNOWN_FAMILY with the matching context.

rules.title: ShellShock channel parameter
rules.rationale: Gate only: ShellShock's channel names link a PHP shell or a capture to the frozen protocol contract.

rules.title: ShellShock encrypted envelope
rules.rationale: Gate only: the SSENC prefix proves an encrypted ShellShock payload without decrypting it.

rules.title: ShellShock response framing
rules.rationale: Gate only: ShellShock's response framing identifies its output inside a carved body.

rules.title: PHP upload part
rules.rationale: Gate only: a .php/.phtml/.phar filename in a multipart part unlocks the upload rules.

rules.title: HTTP request to a PHP script
rules.rationale: Gate only: an HTTP request targeting a .php script unlocks the command-parameter rule.
